h1: The 7 Best Dustpan and Brush Sets for Crumbs, Pet Hair and Tight Corners, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Dustpan and Brush Sets: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 dustpan and brush sets under $25 compared on lip design, bristle type, pet hair combs, storage and size for everyday sweeping.
summary: The OXO Good Grips set is the best dustpan and brush for everyday cleanup, with a soft flexible lip, a whisk-broom brush and a brush that snaps into the pan. The Casabella Wayclean is best for corners, the WDDBHSKN handles pet hair with a built-in comb, and the NACENA is the pick for countertop crumbs.
intro: A dustpan lives or dies by its front edge. A stiff plastic lip leaves a thin line of dust that the brush cannot push in, and you sweep the same crumbs three times. A pliable rubber edge pressed to the boards closes that gap, which is why the humble edge matters more than handle shape, color or price.

All seven sets here cost under $25, so the choice comes down to details: lip material, bristle type, whether the brush cleans itself of hair and how the pair stores. We reviewed the listings for those features and flag where a page says little, such as bristle length or the size of the pan.

products.name: OXO Good Grips Dustpan & Brush Set
products.verdict: A soft full-width lip and a snap-in whisk brush in a portable size.
products.description:
The OXO set pairs a whisk-broom brush with nylon bristles and a dustpan with a soft, flexible, full-width lip. The brush snaps into the pan for storage, and the size is portable. It costs under $25.

It wins because it does the basic job without fuss. The soft lip conforms to uneven floors, so dust slides in instead of piling up, and the whisk shape reaches across a wide strip in one pass. Snap-in storage keeps the pair together in a cabinet. Nothing in it is novel, which is the point.

Buy it for daily kitchen and entry cleanup. It has no comb for pet hair.
pros: Whisk brush covers a wide strip
products.skipIf: Pet hair is your main problem.

products.name: Casabella Wayclean Handheld Angled Dustpan and Brush Set
products.verdict: An angled brush with a pointed tip, rubber bumpers and a comb built into the pan.
products.description:
The Wayclean has an angled brush with a pointed tip and rubber bumpers, a comb built into the dustpan and a soft rubber lip that lies flat. It is a medium size and costs under $25.

The pointed tip is what earns second place: it pokes into baseboard seams, stair edges and door tracks where a flat brush cannot reach. Bumpers protect furniture, and the built-in comb pulls hair out of the bristles. It is a bit bulkier than the OXO.

Buy it for homes with many corners and stairs. Skip it if you want the smallest possible set.

products.name: WDDBHSKN Dustpan and Brush Set with Comb
products.verdict: PET fiber bristles, a wide lip, a non-slip grip and a built-in scraper and comb.
products.description:
This set uses PET fiber bristles, an ergonomic non-slip grip, a wide lip and a built-in scraper and comb teeth for cleaning the brush. It costs under $25.

Pet owners know the real chore is cleaning the brush afterward. Comb teeth on the pan let you drag the bristles through and strip off hair in seconds, and the scraper handles stuck-on debris. The wide lip gathers more per pass. A less known brand means durability is untested.

Buy it for homes with pets or long hair. Ordinary sweeping is handled better by the OXO.
products.idealFor: Homes with pets or long hair.

products.name: NACENA Mini Broom and Dustpan Set
products.verdict: High-density fine bristles and silicone-sealed pan edges for tabletop crumbs.
products.description:
The NACENA mini set has high-density, ultra-fine bristles, an electroplated ABS handle, flexible silicone strips along the pan edge and an anti-slip grip. It is compact and costs under $25.

Fine, dense bristles pick up the smallest crumbs, and silicone edges seal against a counter so nothing escapes. That suits tabletops and small spills. It is too small to sweep a whole floor comfortably.

Buy it for the counter, table or desk. Do not use it as your main floor set.

products.name: MR.SIGA Dustpan and Brush Set with Bamboo Handle
products.verdict: A natural bamboo handle, dense bristles, a soft rubber lip and a hanging loop.
products.description:
The MR.SIGA set pairs a natural bamboo handle with dense bristles, a pliable rubber edge that sits flush on the floor, a hanging loop and a snap-together build. It costs under $25.

Bamboo gives it a warmer look than plastic, which suits a kitchen where the tool hangs on a hook. The soft lip performs like the leaders. It lacks a comb or scraper, so hair needs hand cleaning, and bamboo should not soak in water.

Buy it if it will be on display. Pick the WDDBHSKN if you have pets.
products.idealFor: Kitchens where tools hang on display.

products.name: Amazon Basics Small Portable Mini Dustpan and Brush Set, Pack of 2
products.verdict: Two mini sets with an angled brush and a flush rubber lip, in polypropylene and PET.
products.description:
This pack holds two mini sets made of polypropylene and PET, each with an angled brush and a flush rubber lip. They are portable and cost under $25 for the pair.

Two sets let you leave one in the kitchen and one in a bathroom or car. A flush rubber lip does the essential job. The tradeoff is size: mini pans fill after a few sweeps, so they suit small messes.

Buy it for a second room or a tidy-up kit. It will not replace a full-size set.
products.idealFor: Keeping a set in two rooms.
products.skipIf: You need a main floor set.

products.name: Fabuloso Brush and Dustpan Set
products.verdict: A basic compact set with a sloped pan, snap-together storage and a hanging hole.
products.description:
The Fabuloso set has a compact sloped pan that guides debris, snap-together storage and a hole for hanging on a wall. It costs under $25.

It is last because the listing mentions no lip material, bristle type or comb, so the details that decide quality are unknown. A sloped pan helps a little. It works for quick sweeps in a garage or a caddy.

Buy it as a cheap spare. Choose the OXO for your main set.
products.idealFor: A spare set for a garage or caddy.
products.skipIf: You want a main everyday set.

methodology.title: Lip design
methodology.description: Soft, flush rubber lips ranked above stiff plastic edges, because the lip decides whether fine dust makes it into the pan.

methodology.title: Bristle type
methodology.description: Nylon, PET and fine dense bristles were compared for picking up crumbs and for how easily hair is cleared.

methodology.title: Cleaning features
methodology.description: Built-in combs and scrapers were credited, since cleaning the brush is the chore owners dislike most.

methodology.title: Size and storage
methodology.description: Full, mini and countertop sizes and snap-together or hanging storage were matched to jobs.

methodology.title: Value
methodology.description: All picks cost under $25, so we weighed how complete each listing is and how many jobs a set handles.

whatMatters.detail: A soft rubber or silicone lip bends to the floor and leaves no gap, so fine dust slides in. A hard lip leaves a line behind. Look for words like soft, flexible or flush.
Nylon bristles are stiff and good on rough floors, while fine PET fibers pick up powder and crumbs. Dense bristles last longer. Check which is described.
Combs on the pan edge let you rake hair from the bristles. This matters for pets and long hair. Without it you pull hair out by hand.
Handheld sets suit counters and small areas, while longer handles save your back on floors. A wide pan holds more. Match size to the area you sweep.
Snap-together and hanging-loop designs keep the pair from separating. Hanging saves drawer space. Check that the brush locks in firmly.

howToChoose.intro: Think about what you sweep most, because each set is tuned for something different.

faq.q: Can I use a handheld set on stairs?
faq.a: Yes, and an angled brush like the Casabella helps on stair edges. A longer handle saves bending. Sweep from the top down.

faq.q: What is the common mistake with dustpans?
faq.a: Buying a stiff-lipped pan. It leaves a line of dust. A soft rubber lip lies flat and picks it up.
For pets and long hair, yes. It saves minutes each time. For plain dust it is unnecessary.

faq.q: How do I clean the brush?
faq.a: Shake it out, rake hair with the comb and wash with soapy water occasionally. Let it dry bristles-down. Keep bamboo handles out of standing water.
Bristles bend over time, and rubber lips harden. Replace the set when the lip no longer lies flat. Budget sets may last a year or two.

faq.q: Do mini sets work on floors?
faq.a: They can for small spills, but the pans fill fast. Use them for counters. A full-size set is better for floors.

finalTake: The OXO Good Grips set is the best dustpan and brush for most homes because its soft lip and snap-in brush get the basics right. The Casabella Wayclean handles corners, the WDDBHSKN is the one for pet hair, and the NACENA tidies counters. Keep the Amazon Basics pack as spares.
